name: drupal/paragraph_bundle_content
description: A reusable Content Type for all Paragraphs Bundles to create full width content.

suggest.drupal/apex: Enables APEX theme detection. PbcThemeFamilyResolver uses apex's ThemeDetectionServiceInterface when the module is installed, because it walks the base-theme chain and so recognises apex sub-themes that are not named apex_*. Without it the resolver falls back to a theme-name scan; nothing breaks.
